answer: At dawn, the protocol links equivocation proofs across bonded escrows: when k identities coordinate conflicting votes, their correlated penalty scales as O(k^2), rather than charging each signer independently. Upon detection, the controller’s principal, rewards, and depreciating collateral suffer an exponential multiplier in capital loss, making swarm expansion prohibitive. Any apparent ledge of cheap identities disappears, while honest operators forge only one consistent history.
